name: Single-axis linear rail (ball screw, A6-EC)
revision_source: Owner-approved design 2026-10-12: one ball-screw rail modelled as a rotary external joint with no URDF and no Cartesian participation (jog, Home and joint moves only). The drive-native ratio is the motor turns over the full rail, so the whole rail is one virtual output turn (2*pi rad). See README.md beside this file.

calibration.note: No anchors are embedded. Home is established only by drive HM35 at the rail's mechanical home end; offsets and encoder anchors live in the Home calibration record.

joints.name: J1

gear_ratio.numerator_source: Example design 2026-10-12: screw lead 10 mm/rev x 100 motor turns = 1000 mm rail = one virtual output turn; numerator = motor turns over the full rail (rail length / lead). 1 rad = 1000/(2*pi) = 159.155 mm; 131072 x 100 / 1000 = 13107.2 counts/mm.
gear_ratio.numerator_unverified: unverified: lead and usable rail length are example design values; replace with the installed rail's and measure counts per mm before motion qualification
gear_ratio.denominator_source: Example design 2026-10-12: denominator 1. rtctl requires 131072 x numerator / denominator to be an integer, at most 2147483647 (int32 counts/rev) and above 2 x 640016 counts (the a6ec 128 ms mailbox acquisition allowance must stay below half a turn): numerator/denominator 10..16383, each term at most 65535 (A6-EC 0x2010:19/1A are u16).
gear_ratio.source: Example design 2026-10-12 mechanics, migrated 2026-10-19: software ratio 100/1 in A6-EC linear absolute mode.

joints.motor_encoder_counts_per_rev_source: A6-EC/A6M 17-bit absolute motor encoder, 131072 counts/motor rev, the same model the Rosie 1430 arms use.
joints.motor_encoder_counts_per_rev_unverified: unverified: the rail motor's encoder part number and counts per physical motor revolution are not yet read back
joints.encoder_battery_source: Owner statement 2026-10-12: the rail's encoder cable has a battery box (multi-turn retention). Battery voltage and retention are unmeasured.
joints.sign_unverified: unverified: +1 is a placeholder; confirm that positive motion moves the carriage away from the home end before motion qualification

mechanical_travel.min_unverified: unverified: 5 mm from the home end (5 / 159.155 mm per rad); example design value, measure the hard stop clearance on the installed rail
mechanical_travel.max_unverified: unverified: 995 mm from the home end (995 / 159.155 mm per rad), 5 mm short of one virtual output turn so the span stays below 2*pi; example design value, measure on the installed rail
